title: Observe real EUR shop category event rejected by parser
platforms: Linux interpreter and extracted desktop parser; GUI untested
changes: Connect a semantic category event from a real EUR shop state to the current recording input parser.
validation: Category 0 to 1 emitted event 1025 and changed the guest category while control stayed at 0; the exact extracted parser refused that event. ROM, checkpoint and input sequence hashes unchanged.
limitations: No full application recording, export, replay, native or GUI execution; single EUR category. Isolated harness emitted one unused-field warning.
Managed cleanup rejects U31 units; isolated diagnostic evidence is retained.
